claims.text: The model works best for implicit discourse relations, achieving a macro-average F1-score of 48.82%.
The model shows significant improvements in recognizing Comparison and Temporal relations, indicating better performance in these areas.
The model performs worse on the first three implicit relations compared to other variants, indicating limitations in those areas.
